# Anivora 0.1.40 — Discord integration with the original app UI

- Restore the exact original Profile layout and existing Discord entry. Remove the Community & support row and native community screen added in 0.1.39.
- Keep all existing app features, controls, sections, navigation, services and native plugins byte-for-byte equal to the pre-integration main source. Only the release version/code changes in the Android app configuration.
- Keep the Discord integration on Cloudflare: organized community channels, structured reports and suggestions, private support tickets, native AutoMod, verified release announcements, account-service monitoring, and owner-only community metrics.
- The existing Discord icon continues to open Anivora Community. Discord commands and the external Cloudflare report form provide support without adding native app controls or consuming Render bandwidth.
- Remove the unused authenticated reporting client/backend adapter. Existing authentication and backend routes are preserved; account linking remains disabled.

Android version code **42**, newer than 0.1.39/code 41. Package
`com.brandon300.anivora`; ARM64; Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. Preserve the established
signing certificate and install over the existing app without uninstalling.

## Availability and verification

This supersedes 0.1.39, which included an added Profile support row. Existing app
behavior is preserved, including playback, downloads/HLS/merge, manga, libraries,
history, authentication, comments, notifications, Cast/TV pairing and GitHub updates.

Anivora1 remains suspended for billing/bandwidth until its allowance resets.
Cloudflare community features operate independently. Private GitHub issue automation
needs its own dedicated credential. Discord OAuth linking and two-way private issue
synchronization are not enabled. Discord rejected automated editing of the bot's own
managed role; owner action is still required to reduce Administrator permissions.

Publication requires the established TypeScript, lint, app/backend/bridge tests,
Expo compatibility, Android integration/native tests, compiled-source and package/
signer/integrity checks. Physical Hot 50i/Chromecast QA remains pending.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/5272d3571f16f844080cb9260a5cb9e51124d410
